summary: Lee called the congressional suppression of Gaza death tolls "genocide denial," co-issued a permanent-ceasefire statement as CPC Peace and Security Task Force Chair, and as Oakland Mayor backed halting Israeli military cargo through the Port of Oakland. CAIR Action endorsed her. AIPAC nonetheless thanked her for pro-Israel provisions in H.R.4373 (2021) and the FY2024 $3.3B security package; she also voted yes on an IHRA-mentioning antisemitism resolution. The personal ceasefire work and mayoral port action anchor the assessment.
